blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Video world models promise general-purpose interactive simulators, but their training is limited by action supervision: action labels are scarce, fragmented across incompatible specifications, and do not scale with the unlabeled video pretraining corpus. A common workaround jointly trains an action encoder to compress consecutive frames into a latent action and a decoder to reconstruct the next frame from the previous frame and that latent, forcing the latent to capture only new information. This has two limitations: learning the action space from scratch can limit generalization to unseen domains, and the bottleneck trades expressiveness for separation, with tighter settings losing nuance and looser ones risking scene leakage under domain shifts. We argue for a different starting point: rather than learning actions from scratch, we start from a pretrained foundation model (V-JEPA 2), whose embeddings of a frame pair already carry substantial action information after large-scale, diverse video pretraining. The remaining challenge is to extract the action while discarding the scene. We propose a label-free contrastive adaptation framework that pulls together frame pairs sharing the same motion under a different scene and pushes apart pairs from the same scene with different motion, reshaping the geometry of the pretrained space without imposing a reconstruction bottleneck. We introduce a unified evaluation protocol along three axes (action expressiveness, scene invariance, and action-conditioned video generation quality) across robot manipulation, camera navigation, game, and driving benchmarks, most of which are unseen during adaptation. Compared with annotation-free latent-action methods, our representations are substantially more expressive while matching their scene invariance, and they yield world models that transfer demonstrated actions to new scenes more faithfully.
blocks.zh: 视频世界模型承诺通用交互式模拟器,但其培训受到动作监督的限制:动作标签稀缺,分解不相容的规格,不与未贴标签的视频预训书相适应. 一个共同的工作绕道联合训练一个动作编码器,将相继的相框压缩成一个潜在动作和一个解码器来从上个相框中重建下个相框,以及这个潜在,迫使相框只捕取出新的信息. 这有两个局限性:从零开始学习动作空间可以将通俗化限制在看不见的域上,而瓶颈交易是分离的表达性,更紧的设置会失去细微度,而更松的则在域移下冒着场景被泄露的风险. 我们主张一个不同的起点:我们不是从零开始学习行动,而是从一个预先训练的基础模型(V-JEPA 2)开始,在大规模、多样化的视频预先训练后,一个框架对的嵌入已经包含了实质性的行动信息。 剩下的挑战是在丢弃现场的同时取出动作. 我们提出一个无标签的对比性适应框架,将框架对在不同的场景下共享相同的运动,并用不同的运动将同一场景的对相推开,重塑了预先训练的空间的几何结构而不会强加重建瓶颈. 我们在机器人操纵、相机导航、游戏和驾驶基准三条轴线(动作表达、场景变化和有行动条件的视频生成质量)上引入统一评价协议, 与无注解的潜在行动方法相比,我们的表现在与场景变化相匹配的同时表现得明显地更具表现力,它们产生了将展示出的行动更忠实地转移到新场景的世界模型.

Actions from diverse domains are mapped into a single shared action space, inheriting broad spatio-temporal priors from large-scale video pretraining. These action embeddings can be derived from video frames alone and used to generate videos with the same actions from different initial images across diverse domains. Real actions can also be adaptively mapped into the same action space for real-world control.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Over the past few years, video generative models [ 10 , 21 , 34 , 58 ] have reached unprecedented levels of realism.
They are trained on vast quantities of video data and acquire broad priors over scene structure and dynamics, which has motivated their use well beyond video generation itself.
A growing line of work explores how they can be turned into video world models by conditioning generation on action signals [ 11 , 46 , 20 , 19 ] .
Video world models have the potential to serve as general-purpose interactive simulators, with applications ranging from robotics to gaming.
blocks.zh:
在过去几年中,视频基因模型[10,21,34,58]达到了前所未有的现实主义水平.
他们接受大量视频数据的培训,并获得关于场景结构和动态的广泛前科,这大大超越了视频生成本身。
越来越多的作品探索如何通过在动作信号上调节生成[11,46,20,19],将其转化为视频世界模型.
视频世界模型具有作为通用交互式模拟器的潜力,其应用范围从机器人到游戏.

blocks.en:
Realizing this potential, however, hinges on action supervision.
While unlabeled video is abundant, only a small fraction is paired with the actions that produced it, and the labels that do exist are fragmented across incompatible specifications, such as joint angles in robotics or controller inputs in games.
Direct action conditioning therefore does not scale with the unlabeled video pretraining corpus and does not transfer well across environments.
To overcome this, latent-action models [ 43 , 11 ] extract latent actions from unlabeled video in a self-supervised manner and use them to condition the video generator during pretraining.
Real actions can then be mapped onto this latent space afterward with a small amount of labeled data [ 11 , 19 ] .
blocks.zh:
然而,实现这一潜力取决于行动监督。
虽然没有标签的视频是丰富的,但只有一小部分与产生它的动作配对,而确实存在的标签在不兼容的规格上是零散的,如机器人中的关节角或游戏中的控制器输入.
因此,直接动作条件与未贴标签的视频预培训程序不相称,而且不会很好地跨越环境。
为了克服这种情况,潜伏行动模型[43,11]以自我监督的方式从无标签的视频中提取潜伏动作,并在预训期间利用潜伏动作来对视频生成器进行调制.
然后可以将实际行动映射到这个潜在的空间上,然后用少量贴有标签的数据[11,19].

blocks.en: Latent-action models are typically trained from scratch as inverse-dynamics models: given a pair of consecutive frames, an action encoder infers a latent intended to capture the action, while a decoder reconstructs the next frame from the previous frame together with this latent. A bottleneck on the latent forces it to encode only what the decoder cannot recover from the previous frame alone, ideally isolating the action signal from scene content. This comes with two limitations: first, training the action space from scratch can prevent it from generalizing to unseen domains; second, tightening the bottleneck improves separation between action and scene at the cost of expressiveness, while loosening it preserves nuance at the cost of scene leakage, which can also hurt generalization when scene, embodiment, or dynamics shift.
blocks.zh: 后期动作模型通常从头开始作为反动力模型加以训练:只要一对连续的帧,一个动作编码器就推断出一个旨在捕捉动作的潜伏,而一个解码器则从前一帧重建下一帧,加上这个潜伏. 一个瓶颈 因为它的潜在力量 只能编码解码器无法单独从前一个框架恢复的东西 理想的做法是将动作信号 与场景内容隔离开来 这有两个限制:第一,从零开始训练动作空间可以防止它被概括到看不见的领域;第二,收紧瓶颈可以改善动作和场景之间的分离,以表现力为代价,同时放松它以场景渗漏为代价保持细微性,在场景,浮现,或动态变化时也会损害概括性.

blocks.en:
In this work, we propose OnlyAct, an unlabeled action representation learning framework that takes a different starting point.
Rather than learning the action representation from scratch, we start from a pretrained foundation model, V-JEPA 2 [ 4 ] , and extract actions from it with contrastive learning.
Pretrained on large-scale, diverse video, such a model encodes both what is in a scene and how it changes over time, so the action-relevant signal is already present in its embeddings, alongside scene content.
We confirm this empirically: when a pair of consecutive frames is encoded as a two-frame clip, even the frozen V-JEPA 2 embedding carries more action information than latent-action models trained on the same data, as measured by a linear probe ( Sec. 4.1 ). However, it also carries more scene information ( Sec. 4.2 ), and its probing performance is unstable across domains.
The main challenge is therefore not to learn an action representation from scratch, but to disentangle the action-relevant signal from scene content.
blocks.zh:
在这项工作中,我们提议 " 只有行动 " (Only Act),这是一个没有标签的行动代表学习框架,需要不同的起点。
我们不是从零开始学习动作表现,而是从一个经过预先训练的基础模型(V-JEPA 2[4])开始,从中提取行动,以对比性学习.
预先在大规模,多样的视频上进行训练,这样的模型既编码一个场景中的内容,又编码它如何随时间变化,所以与动作相关的信号已经存在于其嵌入中,与场景内容并列.
我们从经验上证实了这一点:当一对连续的帧被编码为双帧剪辑时,即使是被冻结的V-JEPA 2嵌入的动作信息也比通过线性探测器(Sec.4.1)测量的同一数据所训练的潜伏动作模型携带的动作信息还要多. 然而,它也携带了更多的场景信息(sec.4.2),它的探测性能在各域都不稳定.
因此,主要的挑战不是从零开始学习动作表现,而是将与动作相关的信号从场景内容中分离出来.

blocks.en:
We do this by adapting the pretrained foundation model into an action encoder on unlabeled video with a contrastive objective and a lightweight low-rank adapter.
Given two frames from a video, we form a positive example that keeps the motion but changes the scene: when the camera is static, we use optical flow to cut out the moving region and paste it, at a shifted location, onto the background of a different scene. Hard negatives are drawn from other frame pairs of the same video, where action provides the dominant axis of variation. Together, these signals shift the encoder embedding space toward action.
Crucially, this is achieved without a reconstruction bottleneck: the objective reshapes the geometry of the pretrained space rather than compressing the action into a small code from which the next frame must be decoded.
blocks.zh:
我们通过将预先训练的基础模型 改编成无标签视频上的动作编码器 具有对比性目标和轻量级低等级适配器
鉴于一个视频的两帧,我们形成了一个积极的例子来保持运动,但改变场景:当相机是静态的时,我们使用光学流切除移动区域,并在一个转动的位置将其粘贴到另一个场景的背景上. 硬底片来自同一视频的其他帧对,其中动作提供了变化的主导轴. 这些信号共同使嵌入空间的编码器转向动作.
关键是,这是在没有重建瓶颈的情况下实现的:目标重塑了预先训练的空间的几何,而不是将动作压缩成一个小代码,从中必须解码下一个框架.

blocks.en:
The adapted encoder supports two main uses: transfer from demonstrations, and direct control with real actions. In the first, the encoder extracts a latent action from a pair of demonstration frames; this latent then conditions a video world model to reproduce the same action in a different scene.
In the second, a small action-labeled dataset can be used to map an environment’s real actions onto the latent space, after which the video world model can be controlled directly through them.
blocks.zh:
改编的编码器支持两个主要用途:从演示中转移,和用实际动作直接控制. 首先,编码器从一对演示框中提取了潜伏的动作;这种潜伏的条件是视频世界模型在不同的场景中复制同样的动作.
第二,可以使用一个带有动作标签的小型数据集,将环境的真实行动映射到潜在的空间上,然后可以通过它们直接控制视频世界模型.

blocks.en:
Both uses require an action representation that captures rich and discriminative action dynamics, isolates the action signal from scene content so the same action transfers across scenes, and drives faithful action-conditioned video generation across different domains.
We construct a unified evaluation protocol around these axes and benchmark against prior annotation-free latent-action methods and the frozen pretrained encoder on thirteen robot, camera-navigation, and game datasets, ten of which are unseen during adaptation, as well as on world-model training and fine-tuning across robot, navigation, game, and driving domains.
Our representation is the most expressive on almost all datasets, matches the scene invariance of bottlenecked latent-action models, and yields world models with markedly better action transfer and controllability.
blocks.zh:
两种用途都要求动作表现能够捕捉丰富且具有歧视性的动作动态,将动作信号从场景内容中分离出来,这样同样的动作会跨场景进行传输,并且推动忠实的动作条件视频生成跨越不同领域.
我们围绕这些轴线和基准构建一个统一的评估协议,针对的是事先无注释潜伏操作方法,以及13个机器人、相机导航和游戏数据集上被冻结的预装编码器,其中10个数据集在适应过程中是看不见的,以及机器人、导航、游戏和驱动领域的世界模型培训和微调。
我们的表述在几乎所有数据集中都表现得最为明显,与瓶颈潜在行动模型的场景变化不一相匹配,使世界模型具有明显更好的动作转移和控制能力。

blocks.en: Our main contributions are as follows: 1. We introduce a new perspective on unlabeled action representation learning: rather than learning actions from scratch, we extract them from the representation space of a pretrained foundation model. 2. We propose a label-free contrastive adaptation framework, built on flow-guided scene-swapped positives and same-video hard negatives, that disentangles action from scene without a reconstruction bottleneck and improves both action expressiveness and scene invariance over the frozen encoder. 3. We introduce a unified evaluation protocol that systematically probes action expressiveness, scene invariance, and action-conditioned video generation quality, and show across robot, navigation, game, and driving benchmarks that our representations improve over prior annotation-free latent-action baselines.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Video World Models. Action-conditioned video world models have become a core approach for modeling environment dynamics in domains such as gaming and robotics. Existing methods typically obtain action information in one of two ways. The first assumes explicit action or intervention supervision, such as controller inputs, robot states, camera trajectories, or action prompts [ 3 , 63 , 1 , 56 , 67 , 23 , 53 , 27 , 46 , 20 , 40 , 36 , 54 , 61 , 47 ] . This provides a precise control interface, but the supervision is tied to particular environments, embodiments, or data-collection pipelines, and therefore does not naturally scale to uncurated in-the-wild video. The second introduces latent-action interfaces learned from video [ 11 , 19 , 18 , 64 , 49 , 12 ] , reducing the need for explicit labels but requiring a separate action-learning process. Current interactive video world models therefore face a trade-off between precise but environment-specific action supervision and scalable but separately learned latent actions. Our work is complementary: we use pretrained foundation-model representations as an effective starting point and ask whether they already contain transferable transition structure that can be extracted for world model pretraining.
blocks.zh: 影视世界模特儿. 具备行动条件的视频世界模型已成为游戏和机器人等领域环境动态模型的核心方法。 现有方法通常以两种方式之一获得行动信息。 第一个假设是明确的行动或干预监督,如控制器输入、机器人状态、摄像机轨迹或动作提示[3、63、1、56、67、23、53、27、46、20、40、36、54、61、47] 这提供了精确的控制界面,但监管与特定的环境,化身,或数据收集管道相连,因此不会自然地被放大到未经校验的浑浊视频. 第二段介绍从视频[11、19、18、64、49、12]中汲取的潜在行动接口,减少了明确标签的需要,但需要单独的行动学习过程。 因此,目前互动的视频世界模型在精确但针对具体环境的行动监督与可扩展但单独学到的潜在行动之间面临权衡。 我们的工作是相辅相成的:我们使用经过预先培训的基础模型表述作为有效的起点,并询问它们是否已经包含可转移的过渡结构,这些结构可以提取供世界模型预先培训使用。

blocks.en:
Latent Action Models from Video. A growing line of work learns latent actions from unlabeled video by jointly training an action encoder on frame pairs together with a future-frame
decoder, with a bottleneck on the latent.
Introduced by earlier work [ 16 , 43 , 42 ] and scaled by recent methods [ 11 , 51 , 64 , 19 , 18 , 49 , 12 ] , these latents serve as proxy actions for controllable video generation or policy learning.
The key limitation is generalization: because these encoders are trained from scratch with reconstruction objectives, the learned action space is shaped by the scenes, embodiments, and dynamics present in the training data.
As a result, latents can encode scene-specific cues such as appearance, object identity, or viewpoint rather than the action itself, making transfer difficult when scene or embodiment shifts [ 15 , 66 ] .
Prior methods reduce this leakage with low-dimensional bottlenecks, discrete codebooks, or other architectural constraints, but these constraints come at the cost of reducing the resolution of the action space.
A separate line of work augments reconstruction-based latent-action models with contrastive objectives, but relies on additional supervision such as action labels or kinematic trajectories [ 15 , 66 ] .
We instead start from a pretrained foundation model [ 4 ] and use a contrastive objective to extract action as a signal already present in its embeddings, neither learning the action space from scratch nor requiring additional supervision.

这些潜伏物由早期的工作[16、43、42]提出,并以最近的方法[11、51、64、19、18、49、12]加以扩大,成为可控视频制作或政策学习的代用行动。
关键局限在于概括:因为这些编码器是从零开始以重建目标来训练的,所学到的动作空间是由场景,浮雕,以及培训数据中的动态所塑造的.
因此,潜伏物可以编码特定场景的提示,如外观,物体身份,或视角,而不是动作本身,使得在场景或浮雕转移时的转移困难 [15,66].
先前的方法以低维瓶颈,离散的代码本或其他建筑限制来减少这种渗漏,但这些限制是以降低动作空间的分辨率为代价的.
单独的一行工作可以扩大基于重建的潜在行动模式,具有对比性目标,但依靠额外的监督,如行动标签或运动轨迹[15、66]。
相反,我们从一个预先训练的基础模型[4]开始,使用一个对照目标来提取行动,作为嵌入中已经存在的信号,既不从零开始学习行动空间,也不需要进一步的监督。

blocks.en:
Pretrained Representations. Pretrained visual representations [ 44 , 38 , 60 , 39 , 30 , 68 , 32 , 9 ] provide strong and transferable features for downstream perception, control, and world modeling.
Large-scale foundation models such as V-JEPA 2 [ 4 ] extend this to predictive spatio-temporal representations that support video understanding, and V-JEPA 2-AC further post-trains an action-conditioned predictor in this representation space for planning with robot actions.
These works use pretrained representations to encode observations or predict future states, with actions, when needed, supplied as labels.
We instead use the pretrained foundation model itself as an action encoder: encoding a frame pair as a short clip exposes the motion between the frames, and we adapt the encoder without labels so that this motion signal, rather than scene content, dominates its embedding space.

Following prior latent-action work [ 16 , 11 , 51 , 64 , 19 ] , we define the action as the change between two frames that is caused by the agent or the camera, and treat what can be inferred from a single frame, such as appearance, layout, and object identity, as scene content.
An overview of the training pipeline is provided in Fig. 2 .

blocks.en: 3.1 Frame-Pair Embeddings from a Foundation Model
blocks.zh: 3.1 框架对等 从基金会模式嵌入

blocks.en:
We instantiate the action encoder ϕ θ \phi_{\theta} with the encoder of V-JEPA 2 [ 4 ] , a ViT-L foundation model pretrained on large-scale video.
Because it is pretrained to model how video content evolves across space and time, the encoder represents motion, not only appearance, which makes it a natural starting point from which to extract action representations.

由于它预先训练成模拟视频内容如何跨越时空演化,编码器代表运动,而不仅仅是外观,这使得它成为提取动作表现的自然起点.

blocks.en:
Given a frame pair ( o t , o t + 1 ) (o_{t},o_{t+1}) , we stack the two frames into a two-frame clip and pass it through the encoder only; the V-JEPA 2 predictor is not used.
Since the encoder groups every two frames into one spatio-temporal tubelet, the clip yields a single temporal slice of 16 × 16 16\times 16 patch tokens, and each token jointly observes both frames from the first layer onward.
Motion is therefore fused into the representation from the start, rather than obtained by differencing two independently encoded frames.

The frozen embedding already encodes substantial action information ( Sec. 4.1 ), but it is entangled with scene content: it leaks more scene information than latent-action models ( Sec. 4.2 ), and its action information degrades sharply on some domains.
A low-dimensional reconstruction bottleneck is the standard remedy for scene leakage, but it trades scene invariance against action expressiveness and would discard the capacity that makes the pretrained space attractive in the first place.
We therefore adapt ϕ θ \phi_{\theta} with a contrastive objective that reshapes its geometry without compressing it ( Sec. 3.2 ).

blocks.en: 3.2 Contrastive Action Adaptation
blocks.zh: 3.2 对应行动适应

blocks.en:
Building on the encoder ϕ θ \phi_{\theta} of Sec. 3.1 , we now reshape its embedding space to better isolate action from scene while retaining the capacity of the pretrained representation.
We frame this adaptation around two properties that we want the action embedding space to satisfy: action expressiveness and scene invariance .
Without action labels, neither can be enforced directly, so we approximate both through a contrastive objective on positive and hard-negative pairs that are constructed from raw video.
To avoid overwriting the general-purpose features acquired during pretraining, we keep the pretrained weights θ \theta frozen and attach low-rank adapters [ 26 ] to the linear layers of every transformer block, yielding an update Δ ​ θ \Delta\theta and the adapted encoder ϕ θ + Δ ​ θ \phi_{\theta+\Delta\theta} .
With slight abuse of notation, we write ϕ θ \phi_{\theta} for this adapted encoder in the remainder of the paper, with the understanding that θ \theta subsumes Δ ​ θ \Delta\theta .

我们把这个适应设定在两个属性上, 我们希望动作嵌入空间能够满足:动作表现和场景变化。
没有动作标签,两者都不能直接执行,所以我们通过一个对比目标,在由原始视频构建的正对和硬负对上进行近似.

For each training sample we draw an anchor pair, a positive pair, and a hard-negative pair.
The anchor is a frame pair ( o t , o t + k ) (o_{t},o_{t+k}) from a video, with a small random offset k k .
The positive g ⁡ ( o t , o t + k ) g(o_{t},o_{t+k}) should carry the same action in a different scene.
We construct it with flow-guided scene swapping : we estimate the dense optical flow between the two frames with an off-the-shelf estimator [ 55 ] , and threshold its magnitude to obtain the moving core region, i.e., the pixels that carry the action.
We cut out this region from both frames and paste it onto the same background frame taken from a different scene of the same dataset, translating it in both frames by a common random offset.
The pixels in motion are thus preserved exactly, while the scene, background, and absolute location of the motion are all replaced.
This construction is only valid when the camera is static. When the camera moves, as in egocentric, hand-held, or driving video, the background motion is itself part of the action and cannot be swapped; in this case the positive falls back to the anchor pair under a different photometric augmentation.
Both anchor and positive receive a color jitter that is shared between their two frames, so that inter-frame changes are not altered.
The hard negative ( o t ′ , o t ′ + k ) (o_{t^{\prime}},o_{t^{\prime}+k}) is drawn from a non-overlapping time window of the same video: it shares the scene with the anchor but likely corresponds to a different action, so it cannot be told apart from the anchor by appearance.
We write α t \alpha_{t} , α t + = ϕ θ ​ ( g ⁡ ( o t , o t + k ) ) \alpha_{t}^{+}=\phi_{\theta}\!\bigl(g(o_{t},o_{t+k})\bigr) , and α t − = ϕ θ ​ ( o t ′ , o t ′ + k ) \alpha_{t}^{-}=\phi_{\theta}(o_{t^{\prime}},o_{t^{\prime}+k}) for the embeddings of the anchor, positive, and hard negative, respectively.

blocks.en: 3.3 Action-Conditioned Video World Model
blocks.zh: 3.3 有行动规定 视频世界模式

blocks.en:
We obtain the action-conditioned video world model G ψ G_{\psi} by adopting the autoregressive world model architecture of AdaWorld [ 19 ] and replacing its latent actions by our action stream.
Given a trajectory ( o 1 , … , o T ) (o_{1},\dots,o_{T}) , we apply the frozen action encoder of Sec. 3.1 to consecutive frame pairs to form the action stream α 1 : T − 1 \alpha_{1:T-1} and use it as continuous action conditioning, with G ψ G_{\psi} predicting each next frame o t + 1 o_{t+1} from ( o 1 : t , α 1 : t ) (o_{1:t},\alpha_{1:t}) .
Before entering G ψ G_{\psi} , our action embeddings are whitened by a fixed, parameter-free covariance equalization computed on the training data, while the baselines’ latent actions enter unchanged; whitening a baseline in the same way leads to the same conclusions (Appendix A.2 ).
Otherwise, every action representation we compare uses exactly the same backbone, recipe, and data.

我们通过采用AdaWorld[19]的自递式世界模型架构, 并用我们的行动流来取代其潜在的行动,

blocks.en:
Following AdaWorld, the action representation conditions the denoiser through two pathways: it is concatenated with the CLIP image embedding to form the cross-attention context, and concatenated with the context-length embedding into the vector condition, which a label-embedding MLP maps and adds to the timestep embedding.
One action vector is given per predicted transition, with no learned projection in between, and the action slots of the pretrained weights are zero-initialized. G ψ G_{\psi} predicts the next frame from up to six context frames, with the context length sampled uniformly from 1 to 6 during training, and is trained with the v-prediction objective under EDM noise scaling and loss weighting [ 31 ] .
Each condition, including the action, is dropped with probability 0.1 to enable classifier-free guidance [ 24 ] .

As illustrated in Fig. 3 , the trained pipeline supports two control modes that share the same autoregressive rollout of the video world model G ψ G_{\psi} but differ in how the conditioning action stream α 1 : T − 1 \alpha_{1:T-1} is obtained.
For action transfer , we extract α 1 : T − 1 demo \alpha_{1:T-1}^{\mathrm{demo}} by running the frozen action encoder ϕ θ \phi_{\theta} over a demonstration video and feed it to G ψ G_{\psi} together with an initial frame o 1 o_{1} from a different scene. The model then reproduces the demonstrated action in the new scene without any action labels.
For real-action control , we fine-tune on a small action-labeled set.
Following [ 18 ] , a small learned interface maps real actions into the latent-action space and replaces ϕ θ \phi_{\theta} at the input of G ψ G_{\psi} : one vector per discrete action, initialized at the mean latent action of its labeled clips, or, for continuous actions, a two-layer MLP first fitted to regress the latent actions of the labeled clips.
The interface and the denoiser of G ψ G_{\psi} are then fine-tuned end-to-end (Appendix B.5 ).
Because the latent-action space has already been shaped by large-scale unlabeled pretraining, only a modest amount of labeled data is required, and at inference time the mapped real actions serve as the conditioning stream.

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en:
We evaluate an action representation for action-conditioned video world models along three axes: (i) action expressiveness ( Sec. 4.2 ) — how well the embedding distinguishes different actions; (ii) scene invariance ( Sec. 4.3 ) — whether the embedding avoids encoding scene or future-state content that a video generator could exploit as a shortcut; and (iii) action-conditioned video generation quality ( Sec. 4.4 ) — how well the embedding serves as a conditioning signal for video generation, measured by fidelity, transferability, and controllability.
On both seen and unseen benchmarks, OnlyAct is substantially more expressive than prior annotation-free latent-action baselines, matches their scene invariance, and yields world models with better action transfer and controllability.
Implementation details are provided in Appendix B.1 .
blocks.zh:
我们按照三个轴线评价有行动条件的视频世界模型的行动表现:(一) 动作表现(第4.2节)——嵌入如何区分不同的动作;(二) 场景变化(第4.3节)——嵌入是否避免了视频生成者可用作捷径的编码场景或未来状态内容;(三) 带行动条件的视频生成质量(第4.4节)——嵌入如何以忠实性、可转移性和可控性来衡量,作为视频生成的调节信号。
在可见和未见的基准上, " 只有行动 " 比先前的无注释潜伏行动基线更具表现力,使其场景变化不一,使世界模式具有更好的行动转移和控制能力。

blocks.en: 4.1 Datasets and Baselines
blocks.zh: 4.1 数据集和基线

blocks.en:
We evaluate OnlyAct on datasets both seen and unseen during encoder adaptation. The action encoder is adapted on 168K unlabeled frame-pair samples from nine video sources spanning robot manipulation, human and egocentric video, camera navigation, and games (Appendix B.2 ). Among our evaluation datasets, only LIBERO [ 37 ] , DROID [ 33 ] , and SpatialVID [ 59 ] contribute videos to this set (marked ∘ in the tables), and all other datasets are entirely unseen by the encoder.
For action probing and scene leakage, we use thirteen datasets with action annotations: nine robot-manipulation datasets (LIBERO, DROID, RLBench [ 28 ] , RoboCasa [ 45 ] , DROID-IPRL [ 33 ] , MetaWorld [ 65 ] , MUTEX [ 52 ] , Robosuite [ 70 ] , and RoboDesk [ 29 ] ), three camera-navigation datasets (SpatialVID, ARKitScenes [ 6 ] , and RealEstate10K [ 69 ] ), and Procgen [ 14 ] with 15 discrete actions. For action-conditioned video generation, we evaluate on LIBERO, RLBench, SpatialVID, and nuScenes [ 13 ] , and further fine-tune with real actions on DMLab [ 7 ] and Minecraft from the TECO datasets [ 62 ] , Habitat [ 50 ] in HM3D scenes [ 48 ] , and nuScenes.
blocks.zh:
我们只评价编码器调整时所见所闻和所不见的数据集。 动作编码器在168K无标签的帧-pair样本上改编而成,这些样本来自9个视频来源,涉及机器人操纵,人和以自我为中心的视频,相机导航,以及游戏(附录B.2 ). 在我们的评价数据集中,只有LIBERO [37],DROID [33],和SpaceVID [59] 为本集提供视频(在表格中标注),所有其他数据集被编码器完全看不到.
对于动作探测和场景渗漏,我们使用13个带有动作说明的数据集:9个机器人操纵数据集(LIBERO, DROID, RL Bench [28], RoboCasa [45], DROID-IPRL [33], MetaWorld [65],MUTEX [52],Robosuite [70],和RoboDesk [29]),3个相机导航数据集(SpatialVID,ARKitScens [6],和RealEstate 10K [69]),和Procgen [14],有15个独立的动作. 以及TECO数据集的Minecraft [62]、HM3D场景 [48] 和 nuScenes。

blocks.en:
We compare against two families of baselines. The first is latent-action models, namely DreamDojo [ 18 ] and AdaWorld [ 19 ] . Since their publicly released weights are not trained on our data, we retrain both on the same 168K training pairs as our encoder for a fair comparison (marked † ).
The second is the frozen V-JEPA 2 encoder [ 4 ] , embedded in the same way as OnlyAct ( Sec. 3.1 ) but without contrastive adaptation, which isolates the effect of our adaptation from that of the pretrained backbone.
blocks.zh:

第二种是冰冻的V-JEPA 2编码器[4],其嵌入方式与Only Act(第3.1节)相同,但没有形成对比的适应,它将我们的适应效果与预先训练的骨干的效果隔离开来.

blocks.en: 4.2 Action Expressiveness
blocks.zh: 4.2 行动表现

blocks.en: To evaluate whether the representation captures rich and discriminative action dynamics, we conduct action probing experiments. Specifically, we train a linear probe to predict ground-truth actions from each representation, and report the results in Sec. 4.1 (details in Appendix B.3 ).
blocks.zh: 为了评估这种表现是否包含丰富和歧视性的行动动态,我们进行了行动测试。 具体地说,我们培训了一个线性探测器,以预测每一代表的地面真实行动,并在第4.1节中报告结果(详见附录B.3)。

blocks.en:
As shown in Sec. 4.1 , OnlyAct captures more expressive and discriminative action dynamics than the baselines on 11 of the 13 benchmarks, raising the average R 2 R^{2} from 0.211 for the strongest latent-action model to 0.490.
The frozen V-JEPA 2 encoder already outperforms the latent-action models on average, confirming that the pretrained foundation model provides a strong starting point for action representation. However, its action information is unreliable across domains, and on DROID and RoboCasa its R 2 R^{2} even falls below that of the latent-action models.
Contrastive adaptation removes these failure cases and improves the average R 2 R^{2} from 0.347 to 0.490, with large gains also on datasets unseen during adaptation (e.g., +0.69 on RoboCasa and +0.25 on Robosuite). We attribute this improved transferability to the broad spatio-temporal priors of the pretrained foundation model, which the adaptation preserves rather than overwrites.
blocks.zh:
如世嘉所显. 4.1, " Only Act " 比13个基准中的11个基准的基线更能反映表现性和歧视性行动动态,将最强潜在行动模型的平均R 2 R^{2}从0.211提高到0.490。
冻结的V-JEPA 2编码器平均已经超过了潜在行动模型,证实预先训练的基础模型为行动表现提供了一个强有力的起点。 然而,它的行动信息在各个领域都不可靠,关于DROID和RoboCasa,它的R 2 R^{2}甚至低于潜在行动模式。
相互矛盾的适应消除了这些故障案例,并将平均R 2 RQQQ2}从0.347提高到0.490,在适应过程中所未见的数据集方面也取得了很大收益(例如,RoboCasa的+0.69和Robosuite的+0.25)。 我们把这种改进的可转移性归因于预先训练的基础模型的大致前传,适应方法保留而不是覆盖。

blocks.en: High action prediction accuracy alone, however, does not guarantee a representation suitable for action-conditioned video generation, as we analyze next.

blocks.en: 4.3 Scene Invariance
blocks.zh: 4.3 场景变化

blocks.en: Since action embeddings are inferred from consecutive frames, they may inadvertently encode future-state information that a video model can exploit as a shortcut, directly reconstructing future content rather than learning genuine action-conditioned dynamics and thereby hurting both controllability and transferability.
blocks.zh: 由于动作嵌入是从连续的帧推断出来的,它们可能无意中将未来状态信息编码为视频模型可以用作捷径,直接重建未来内容,而不是学习真实的行动条件动态,从而损害可控性和可转移性.

blocks.en: To quantify how much scene information is encoded in the action embeddings, we train a decoder to reconstruct the future frame from the action embedding alone and evaluate it on held-out scenes. A more scene-invariant embedding should yield worse reconstruction. The results in Sec. 4.2 show that the frozen V-JEPA 2 embedding leaks the most scene information (average LPIPS 0.275). With contrastive adaptation, however, OnlyAct matches the scene invariance of latent-action models, attaining the highest average LPIPS (0.304) and comparable SSIM and L1, while retaining a substantially more expressive action representation. The adaptation therefore improves expressiveness and scene invariance together, without relying on a bottleneck. The right side of Fig. 4 further shows that OnlyAct embeddings form meaningful clusters for the same actions across different datasets. The decoder structure is described in Appendix B.4 .
blocks.zh: 为了量化在动作嵌入中编码了多少场景信息,我们训练一个解码器从动作单独嵌入中重建未来的帧,并在被搁置的场景中加以评价. 增加场景变化性的嵌入会导致重建更加糟糕。 sec.4.2的结果显示,冰冻的V-JEPA 2嵌入式泄露了最多的场景信息(平均LPIPS 0.275. 然而,随着对比性的适应,《只有行动法》与潜在行动模型的场景变化一致,达到了最高的平均数LPIPS(0.304)和可比的SSIM和L1,同时保留了明显更具表现力的行动表现。 因此,这种适应改进了表达力和场景的失常性,而不依赖于瓶颈。 图4的右侧进一步显示,只有嵌入式(OnlyAct)为不同数据集的相同动作组成有意义的集群. 解码器结构在附录B.4中描述.

blocks.en: 4.4 Action-Conditioned Video Generation Quality
blocks.zh: 4.4 有条件的行动 视频生成质量

blocks.en: The ultimate goal of the learned action representation is to provide a general conditioning signal for action-conditioned video generation. We hypothesize that embeddings that are both expressive and scene-invariant enable a video model to learn action-conditioned dynamics more effectively, generalize across domains, and transfer to downstream tasks after lightweight fine-tuning with real actions.
blocks.zh: 所学动作表现的最终目的是为具备动作条件的视频制作提供一般的调制信号. 我们假设,嵌入既具有表现性又具有场景变化性的图像模型能够更有效地学习行动条件的动态,跨域通用,并在轻量级微调后与真实动作转移给下游任务.

blocks.en: To evaluate this hypothesis, we train the same action-conditioned autoregressive world model ( Sec. 3.3 ) with each action representation as input, using the same backbone, recipe, and data for all of them. We assess generation quality along three sub-axes: fidelity , transferability , and controllability . Fidelity is measured by the PSNR of generations driven by the actions inferred from the clip itself (Self PSNR). Transferability is measured by driving a different scene with the actions of a source clip and computing the cosine between the optical-flow direction [ 17 ] of the generated video and that of the source (Transfer Dir), where 0 means unrelated and 1 means the same direction. Since a representation that leaks scene content can reach a high Self PSNR by reconstructing the future frame but cannot carry its action to a new scene, Transfer Dir is the more direct test of an action representation.
blocks.zh: 为了评价这个假设,我们训练了同样的行动条件自动递减世界模型(第3.3节),每个动作代表作为输入,使用同样的主干,食谱,以及所有动作的数据. 我们沿着三个小轴评估生成质量:忠诚、可转移性和可控制性。 从剪辑本身(Self PSNR)推断出的动作所驱动的几代人PSNR衡量了贞洁度. 可转移性通过驱动不同场景与源剪辑的动作进行测量,并在生成的视频的光电流方向[17]和源(Transfer Dir)之间计算余弦,其中0表示无关,1表示相同方向. 由于泄露场景内容的表示可以通过重建未来的帧而达到高自定PSNR,但不能将其动作带到新的场景,所以Transfer Dir是对动作表现的更直接的测试.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
We presented OnlyAct, a scalable approach to action representation learning for video world models.
Previous latent-action models typically learn action spaces from scratch using unlabeled videos, often relying on restrictive bottlenecks to disentangle actions from scene content. In contrast, OnlyAct adapts a pretrained foundation model into an action encoder and uses a label-free contrastive objective, with flow-guided scene-swapped positives and same-video hard negatives, to steer its embeddings towards action-centric representations, without imposing such a bottleneck.
We show that the resulting action representations are substantially more expressive than those learned by prior annotation-free latent-action methods while matching their scene invariance, and that they enable world models with better action transfer and controllability on new domains.

blocks.en: A.2 Whitening Control
blocks.zh: A.2 白化控制

blocks.en: Only the OnlyAct embeddings are whitened before entering the world model (Appendix B.1 ), while the baselines in Sec. 4.4 use their latent actions unchanged. To check that the whitening is not what drives the comparison, we train a second DreamDojo † world model whose latent actions pass through the same whitening rule, with statistics computed on its own embeddings of the same training clips, and keep everything else identical (backbone, recipe, data, seed, and sampler). Sec. A.2 evaluates it on the same clips and source–target pairs as Sec. 4.4 . Whitening changes DreamDojo’s results only slightly (by at most 0.23 dB in Self PSNR and 0.023 in Transfer Dir). OnlyAct remains ahead of the whitened DreamDojo in Self PSNR on LIBERO and RLBench and in Transfer Dir on LIBERO, is level with it in Self PSNR on SpatialVID, and keeps a positive but not statistically significant lead in Transfer Dir on SpatialVID. The whitening therefore does not explain the advantage of OnlyAct.

blocks.en: A.3 Multimodal Embedding Backbone
blocks.zh: A.3 嵌入后骨的多式联运

blocks.en: The submitted version of this work extracted actions from a multimodal embedding model, Qwen3-VL-Embedding-8B [ 35 ] , instead of V-JEPA 2. To compare the two backbones under identical conditions, we apply the OnlyAct recipe unchanged to Qwen3-VL-Embedding-8B: the same 168K training pairs, augmentation, positives and hard negatives, loss, optimizer, schedule and 10,000 steps (Appendix B.2 ). Only the backbone, its input format and its LoRA targets differ. A frame pair is resized and center-cropped to 256 × 256 256{\times}256 exactly as for V-JEPA 2 and given to the model as two images after the instruction “Describe what action is happening in this scene as an embedding.” ; the embedding is the model’s own last-token hidden state (4096-d), mapped to 640 dimensions by a fixed random linear layer and ℓ 2 \ell_{2} -normalized, as for OnlyAct. LoRA adapters with the same rank 16, α = 32 \alpha{=}32 and dropout 0.05 as OnlyAct are attached to the query, key, value and MLP projections of the language model (41.6M trainable parameters; with gradient checkpointing, training fits on one RTX 4090). Action expressiveness and scene leakage are evaluated with exactly the protocols, clips, splits and seeds of Secs. 4.1 and 4.2 .

blocks.en: The contrastive task itself is learned: the anchor-to-positive retrieval accuracy among the five in-batch candidates (chance 0.20) rises from 0.72 over the first 500 steps to 0.96 over the last 2,000 (0.98 for OnlyAct over the same steps). The resulting representation, however, carries much less action information than OnlyAct ( Table 6 , left): its average probe R 2 R^{2} is 0.142 against 0.490, it is lower on all 13 datasets, and it is also below the frozen V-JEPA 2 embedding (0.347). It lets slightly less of the scene be reconstructed than OnlyAct ( Table 6 , right; average held-out LPIPS 0.315 vs. 0.304), as expected for a representation that carries less information overall, which is why scene leakage has to be read together with action expressiveness: OnlyAct gains 0.35 in average R 2 R^{2} for 0.011 in average LPIPS. These results motivated the switch to V-JEPA 2 in the final version; the results reported for the multimodal backbone in the submitted version are superseded by this re-evaluation.

blocks.en: B.1 Implementation Details
blocks.zh: B.1 执行细节

blocks.en: We use the encoder of V-JEPA 2 ViT-L ( vjepa2-vitl-fpc64-256 ; 24 layers, hidden size 1024, 16 × 16 16{\times}16 patches, tubelet size 2) [ 4 ] . Frames are resized to a short side of 292, center-cropped to 256 × 256 256{\times}256 , and normalized with ImageNet statistics using the official V-JEPA 2 preprocessing. A frame pair is stacked into a two-frame clip, which produces a single temporal slice of 16 × 16 = 256 16{\times}16{=}256 tokens; the V-JEPA 2 predictor is not used. The output tokens are average-pooled to a 1024-dimensional vector, projected to 640 dimensions by a linear map that is randomly initialized (seed 0) and kept fixed, and ℓ 2 \ell_{2} -normalized.
blocks.zh: 我们使用V-JEPA 2 VIT-L的编码器(vjepa2-vitl-fpc64-256); 24层,隐藏大小 1024, 16×16 16 时 16 个补丁, 管状大小 2) [4]. 框架被调整为292的短边,中圈为256×256\256\times}256,并使用官方的V-JEPA 2预处理与ImageNet统计正常化. 一帧对被叠成两帧夹片,它产生一个16×16 = 256 16{\times}16×256令牌的单时切片;没有使用V-JEPA 2预测器. 输出符被平均集合到一个1024维向量,通过随机初始化(种子0)并保持固定的线性映射到640维,和l 2\ell\2} - 正常化.

blocks.en: We attach LoRA adapters [ 26 ] with rank 16 16 , α = 32 \alpha{=}32 , and dropout 0.05 0.05 to the query, key, value, and output projections of the attention and to both MLP layers in all 24 encoder blocks, as well as to the patch-embedding convolution. The pretrained weights are frozen and kept in bf16. This amounts to 7.1M trainable parameters, about 2.3% of the 300M encoder parameters.
blocks.zh: 将LORA适配器 [26] 等级为16 16, α = 32 α = α = 32 = α = 32, 和 退位 0.05 0.05 附加到注意力的查询、键、值和输出预测以及所有24个编码器块的 MLP 层, 以及补丁结合的演化中。 预训重量被冷冻并保存在bf16中. 这相当于7.1M可训练参数,约占300M编码器参数的2.3%.

blocks.en: We use the AdaWorld world model [ 19 ] as the backbone for all action representations. We attach LoRA adapters with rank 128 128 and α = 128 \alpha{=}128 to the query, key, value, and output projections of the denoiser attention, and train the label-embedding MLP in full, which amounts to 61.5M trainable parameters for OnlyAct and 55.7M for the 32-dimensional latent-action baselines. We use AdamW with a learning rate of 5 × 10 − 5 5{\times}10^{-5} , 1k linear warm-up steps followed by a constant schedule, a batch of 4 clips of 7 frames, 20k training steps, bf16 precision, gradient clipping at 0.3, no EMA, and seed 32. All world models are trained on the same 19,946 clips (25 frames, 256 × 256 256{\times}256 ) from 9 datasets. Before entering the world model, the OnlyAct embeddings are whitened by a fixed, parameter-free covariance equalization. Each dimension is first standardized; the covariance C = Q ​ diag ​ ( e ) ​ Q ⊤ C=Q\,\mathrm{diag}(e)\,Q^{\top} of the standardized embeddings z z is then equalized as y = z ​ Q ​ diag ​ ( g ) ​ Q ⊤ y=z\,Q\,\mathrm{diag}(g)\,Q^{\top} with gains g i = s / e i + r g_{i}=s/\sqrt{e_{i}+r} , where the ridge r ≥ 0 r\geq 0 is the smallest value for which no gain exceeds 2, and s s keeps the total variance equal to the dimensionality, so that no direction is removed. All statistics are computed once on the 478,704 frame pairs of the world-model training clips. The latent actions of AdaWorld and DreamDojo enter the world model unchanged; Appendix A.2 reports a DreamDojo world model trained with the same whitening. Sampling uses the Euler EDM sampler with 25 steps, a guidance scale of 1.1, and 6 context frames, rolled out autoregressively for 19 frames. Each world model takes about 5 GPU-hours on a single RTX 4090.

blocks.en: B.2 Contrastive Learning Details
blocks.zh: B.2 相互矛盾的学习细节

blocks.en: No action labels are used in this stage. We pre-sample 168K training samples from nine video sources with the following sampling weights: VPT Minecraft [ 5 ] 0.25, CALVIN [ 41 ] 0.15, SpatialVID [ 59 ] 0.15, AgiBot World [ 2 ] 0.10, EgoDex [ 25 ] 0.10, Something-Something v2 [ 22 ] 0.10, and LIBERO [ 37 ] , DROID [ 33 ] , and Atari [ 8 ] 0.05 each.
blocks.zh: 此阶段不使用动作标签. 我们从9个视频来源对168K的训练样本进行预先取样,其取样重量如下:VPT Minecraft [5] 0.25, CALVIN [41] 0.15, SpaceVID [59] 0.15, AgiBot World [2] 0.10, EgoDex [25] 0.10, Something v2 [22] 0.10, LIBERO [37], DROID [33], Atari [8] 0.05。

blocks.en: The anchor is a frame pair ( o t , o t + k ) (o_{t},o_{t+k}) from one video, with k k sampled uniformly from { 1 , 2 , 3 } \{1,2,3\} . Both frames receive the same color jitter (brightness, contrast, and saturation ± 0.3 \pm 0.3 , hue ± 0.05 \pm 0.05 ).
blocks.zh: 锚是框对(o t, o t + k) (o_{t}, o_{t+k}) 从一个视频中, 两个帧都得到相同的颜色快感(亮度,对比度,饱和度±0.3\pm 0.3, hue±0.05\pm 0.05).

blocks.en: We first decide whether the camera is static by the mean optical-flow magnitude of the background: if it is at most 0.5 pixels, the camera is treated as static. In this case, we compute the moving core region as the pixels whose flow magnitude exceeds max ⁡ ( 1 ​ px , 0.35 × q 99 ) \max(1\,\text{px},\,0.35\times q_{99}) , where q 99 q_{99} is the 99th percentile of the flow magnitude, without dilation or feathering. We cut out the original pixels of this region from both frames and paste them onto the same background frame, taken from a different scene of the same dataset, translated in both frames by a common random integer offset of at least 16 pixels. The moving pixels are therefore preserved exactly, while the scene and the absolute location of the motion are replaced. A color jitter shared between the two frames is applied afterwards. When the camera moves (e.g., hand-held, egocentric, or driving video), the background motion is itself part of the action and cannot be replaced; the positive then falls back to the anchor pair under a different color-jitter draw. During training, about 43% of samples use the scene-swapping path (mean over the training log): it dominates on static-camera datasets (LIBERO 99%, DROID 88%, Atari 75%, AgiBot World 62%), whereas hand-held and ego-motion datasets mostly fall back. Optical flow is precomputed with RAFT-large [ 55 ] (12 iterations, 256 × 256 256{\times}256 input).
blocks.zh: 我们首先根据背景的平均光学流度来决定相机是否是静态的:如果最多是0.5像素,相机就被当作静态处理. 在这种情况下,我们将移动的核心区域计算为流量大于最大值的像素(1 px,0.35 × q 99)\max(1\,\text{px},\,0.35\ times q_{99}),其中q 99 q_{99}是流量级的第99百分位,没有放大或羽毛. 我们从两个帧中剪除这个区域的原始像素,并将它们粘贴在同一个背景帧中,取自同一个数据集的不同场景,在两个帧中由至少16像素的常见随机整数抵消来翻译. 因此移动的像素被精确保留下来,而场景和运动的绝对位置则被替换. 之后将使用两个框架之间共享的颜色焦点。 当镜头移动时(例如手持,自我中心,或驱动视频),背景运动本身是动作的一部分,不能被替换;阳性则在不同的色滑动画下返回锚对. 在培训期间,大约43%的样本使用现场扫描路径(平均在培训日志之上):在静态相机数据集上占据主导地位(LIBERO 99%,DROID 88%,Atari 75%,AgiBot World 62%),而手持和自动机数据集大多回落. 光学流与RAFT-大[55](12个迭代,256×256×256}256输入)预算.

blocks.en: The hard negative is a frame pair from a different, non-overlapping time window of the same video as the anchor. It shares the scene with the anchor but generally corresponds to a different action.
blocks.zh: 硬底片是来自不同,非重叠时间窗口的帧对,与主播相同. 它与主播分享场景,但一般对应不同的动作.

blocks.en: We use the symmetric InfoNCE loss of Sec. 3.2 with temperature τ = 0.07 \tau{=}0.07 , over a candidate bank formed by all anchors, positives, and hard negatives in the batch. We train on a single RTX 4090 with 2 samples per step, so that each query is contrasted against one positive and four negatives: its own same-video hard negative and the anchor, positive, and hard negative of the other sample; we accumulate gradients over 8 steps for an effective batch size of 16 (gradient accumulation does not enlarge the negative set, and no memory queue is used). We use AdamW with learning rate 10 − 4 10^{-4} , 500 warm-up steps followed by cosine decay to zero, no weight decay, and seed 0, for 10,000 updates (about 160K samples, roughly one pass over the training set). At the end of training, the positive is retrieved for every query (chance: 0.2), and the mean cosine similarity is 0.88 to the positive and 0.215 to the hard negative, compared with about 0.94 for both at initialization.
blocks.zh: 我们用对称的InfoNCE损失的3.2Sec,温度=0.07\tau=0.07,在批量中用所有锚,正,硬底组成一个候选银行. 我们在一个单列的RTX 4090上训练,每步2个样本,这样每个查询就与一个正反和四个负对比:它自己的同一视频硬底和另一个样本的锚,正反和硬底;我们为有效批量大小16而累积了8个步骤的梯度(梯度累积不会扩大负数集,没有使用内存队列). 我们使用 AdamW 的学习率 10 - 4 10 - 4 Q 4 }, 500 个热身步骤, 之后的余弦衰减到0, 没有重力衰减, 种子 0 , 用于 10,000 个更新( 大约 160K 样本, 大约 1 个通过训练集) 。 训练结束后,每一次查询(chance:0.2)都会检索正数,平均余弦相似度为0.88对正数,0.215对硬负数,而初始化时两者均约为0.94.

blocks.en: B.3 Action Expressiveness Details
blocks.zh: B.3 动作表现细节

blocks.en: For each embedding family, we train an independent linear probe W ∈ ℝ D × K W\in\mathbb{R}^{D\times K} (zero-initialized weight and bias) to map the per-pair embedding z t ∈ ℝ D z_{t}\in\mathbb{R}^{D} (for OnlyAct, z t = α t z_{t}=\alpha_{t} from Sec. 3.1 ) to the ground-truth action a t a_{t} , where D D is the embedding dimensionality and K K is the action dimensionality for continuous datasets or the number of classes for the discrete datasets. Inputs are z z -scored using mean and standard deviation estimated from a 20,000 20{,}000 -sample subset of the training split; for continuous datasets, the targets are z z -scored with the same procedure, and for the discrete datasets, we apply softmax cross-entropy directly. blocks.en: Appendix D Limitations
blocks.zh: 附录D 限制

blocks.en: OnlyAct demonstrates that action representations can be extracted from a pretrained foundation model and adapted for action-conditioned video world models without explicit action labels. However, several limitations remain. First, the method inherits both the strengths and weaknesses of the underlying foundation model. Although large-scale video pretraining provides broad spatio-temporal priors that improve transfer, the resulting action space may still reflect biases in the pretraining distribution, and its performance may degrade for domains with visual dynamics, embodiments, or interaction patterns that are poorly represented in that data. Second, OnlyAct relies on positive pairs that preserve the underlying action while changing the scene. Flow-guided scene swapping is only applicable to static cameras; for moving cameras we fall back to photometric augmentation, which provides a weaker scene-invariance signal. Optical-flow errors, thin or occluded moving parts, and interactions whose effect extends beyond the moving region may also make the swapped positive imperfect. Third, the contrastive stage uses a small batch with few negatives per query and saturates before the end of training, so larger batches, negative queues, or harder negatives may further improve the representation. Fourth, while contrastive adaptation substantially reduces scene leakage, it does not provide a formal guarantee that the learned representation is fully disentangled from scene content or future-state information.
blocks.zh: Only Act 显示,动作表现可以从预先训练的基础模型中抽取出来,并改编为具有动作条件的视频世界模型,没有明确的动作标签. 然而,仍然存在若干限制。 首先,这种方法继承了基础模型的优缺点. 虽然大规模视频预训提供了广泛的时空前传,改进了传输,但由此产生的行动空间仍然可能反映培训前分发中的偏差,其性能可能会因视觉动态、浮雕或互动模式在数据中表现不佳而退化。 第二,OnlyAct依赖于在改变场景的同时保留基础动作的正对. 流导场景互换仅适用于静态摄像头;对于移动摄像头,我们回落到光度增强,这提供了较弱的场景变化信号. 光学流误差,薄薄或渗漏的移动部分,以及其影响延伸到移动区域以外的相互作用,也可能使互换的正差不完美. 三,对比阶段采用小批次,每个查询少有负数,在训练结束前饱和,因此,较大的批次,负队列,或更硬的负数可能进一步改善表现. 第四,虽然对比性适应可大大减少场景渗漏,但并不能提供正式保证,使所学表现完全脱离场景内容或未来状态信息。

blocks.en: In addition, real-action control still requires a small amount of action-labeled data to align environment-specific actions with the learned latent-action space. While this requirement is substantially weaker than training fully supervised action-conditioned models, it means that OnlyAct is not entirely label-free for direct control. Finally, our experiments cover robot manipulation, camera navigation, game, and driving data, but they remain offline evaluations. Further work is needed to evaluate robustness in long-horizon closed-loop interaction, real-world robotics, safety-critical settings, and domains involving complex multi-agent behavior.
blocks.zh: 此外,实际行动控制仍需要少量行动标记数据,以便使针对具体环境的行动与所学到的潜在行动空间保持一致。 虽然这一要求大大弱于训练得到充分监督的行动条件模型,但这意味着只有行动法并非完全无标签的直接控制。 最后,我们的实验涵盖了机器人操纵,相机导航,游戏,和驱动数据,但它们仍然是离线评价. 还需要开展进一步的工作,评价长视闭路互动、现实世界机器人、安全关键环境以及涉及复杂多代理行为的领域的稳健性。

blocks.en: Appendix E Broader Impact
blocks.zh: 附录E 更广泛的影响

blocks.en: This work aims to reduce the dependence of video world models on expensive and fragmented action annotations. By extracting action representations from unlabeled video, OnlyAct could make it easier to train controllable simulators across domains where explicit action labels are difficult to obtain, including robotics, embodied AI, game environments, and interactive content creation. In robotics, such representations may support more scalable learning from observational video and lower the annotation burden for adapting world models to new embodiments. In gaming and simulation, they may enable more reusable action interfaces across visually diverse environments.
blocks.zh: 这项工作旨在减少视频世界模型对昂贵且零散的行动说明的依赖. 通过从未贴标签的视频中提取动作表示,OnlyAct可以更容易地在明确动作标记难以获得的领域,包括机器人,包含的AI,游戏环境,以及互动内容的创建,训练可控模拟器. 在机器人学中,这种表述可能支持从观测视频中进行更可扩展的学习,并减轻使世界模型适应新表现的注释负担。 在游戏和模拟中,它们可以使各种视觉环境中的更多可重复使用的行动界面。

blocks.en: At the same time, more capable action-conditioned video world models raise several risks. If deployed without safeguards, they could be used to generate misleading interactive simulations or synthetic videos that appear physically plausible but do not faithfully reflect real-world dynamics. In robotics or embodied decision-making, inaccurate predictions could lead to unsafe behavior if treated as reliable simulators without appropriate validation. Because OnlyAct builds on a foundation model pretrained on large-scale web video, it may also inherit biases from that data, potentially leading to uneven performance across environments, objects, cultures, or human activities. Moreover, models that learn action structure from unlabeled video may amplify privacy concerns if trained on videos containing people or sensitive environments.
blocks.zh: 同时,更有能力的动作有条件的视频世界模型也带来了几种风险. 如果在没有保障措施的情况下部署,它们可以被用来产生误导性的互动模拟或合成视频,这些视频看起来在物理上是可信的,但没有忠实地反映现实世界的动态。 在机器人或包含的决策中,不准确的预测如果作为可靠的模拟器处理而不经过适当的验证,可能导致不安全的行为. 由于OnlyAct建立在大规模网络视频上预先训练的基础模型上,它也可能继承这些数据的偏差,可能导致环境、物体、文化或人类活动之间的表现不平衡。 此外,从没有标签的视频中学习动作结构的模型,如果在包含个人或敏感环境的视频方面接受培训,可能会扩大隐私关切。

blocks.en: We therefore view OnlyAct primarily as a research step toward scalable action representation learning rather than a ready-to-deploy simulator for safety-critical decision-making. Responsible use should include careful dataset curation, evaluation for domain-specific failure modes, transparency about synthetic generation, and validation before deployment in real-world control systems. Releasing code, models, and evaluation protocols can help the community better audit the learned representations, reproduce results, and study both the benefits and risks of annotation-free action-conditioned world modeling.
blocks.zh: 因此,我们认为,“只有行动”主要是一种研究步骤,旨在学习可扩展的行动代表性,而不是一个随时可以部署的模拟器,用于安全关键的决策。 负责任的使用应当包括仔细的数据集校准,针对特定域的故障模式的评价,合成生成的透明度,以及在实际世界控制系统中部署之前的验证. 发布代码、模型和评价协议可以帮助社区更好地审计学到的表述,复制结果,并研究无注释无行动条件的世界建模的好处和风险。

blocks.en: 1. Claims Question: Do the main claims made in the abstract and introduction accurately reflect the paper’s contributions and scope? Answer: [Yes] Justification: The abstract and Sec. 3 state the three claims of the paper—extracting action representations from a pretrained foundation model (V-JEPA 2), a label-free contrastive adaptation that disentangles action from scene without a reconstruction bottleneck, and a unified evaluation across robot, navigation, game, and driving benchmarks—which are matched by the method in Sec. 3 and the experiments in Sec. 4.3 and the surrounding subsections. Guidelines: • The answer [N/A] means that the abstract and introduction do not include the claims made in the paper. • The abstract and/or introduction should clearly state the claims made, including the contributions made in the paper and important assumptions and limitations. A [No] or [N/A] answer to this question will not be perceived well by the reviewers. • The claims made should match theoretical and experimental results, and reflect how much the results can be expected to generalize to other settings. • It is fine to include aspirational goals as motivation as long as it is clear that these goals are not attained by the paper. 2. Limitations Question: Does the paper discuss the limitations of the work performed by the authors? Guidelines: • The answer [N/A] means that the paper has no limitation while the answer [No] means that the paper has limitations, but those are not discussed in the paper. • The authors are encouraged to create a separate “Limitations” section in their paper. • The paper should point out any strong assumptions and how robust the results are to violations of these assumptions (e.g., independence assumptions, noiseless settings, model well-specification, asymptotic approximations only holding locally). The authors should reflect on how these assumptions might be violated in practice and what the implications would be. • The authors should reflect on the scope of the claims made, e.g., if the approach was only tested on a few datasets or with a few runs. For example, a facial recognition algorithm may perform poorly when image resolution is low or images are taken in low lighting. The authors should use their best judgment and recognize that individual actions in favor of transparency play an important role in developing norms that preserve the integrity of the community. Reviewers will be specifically instructed to not penalize honesty concerning limitations. 3. Theory assumptions and proofs Question: For each theoretical result, does the paper provide the full set of assumptions and a complete (and correct) proof? Guidelines: • The answer [N/A] means that the paper does not include theoretical results. • All the theorems, formulas, and proofs in the paper should be numbered and cross-referenced. • All assumptions should be clearly stated or referenced in the statement of any theorems. • The proofs can either appear in the main paper or the supplemental material, but if they appear in the supplemental material, the authors are encouraged to provide a short proof sketch to provide intuition. • Inversely, any informal proof provided in the core of the paper should be complemented by formal proofs provided in appendix or supplemental material. • Theorems and Lemmas that the proof relies upon should be properly referenced. 4.
